method: Real GameWorld/PlayerController at 60Hz; nearest-target aim, first available non-pistol slot; elliptical orbit, flee within100px; ability whenever nearest within300px and ready. Loot variant targets nearest pickup when enemy farther150px. Kite: full-speed tangent around arena center, summed repulsion within220px plus130px wall avoidance. Passive: no movement/fire/abilities. Range-aware policy: half-mutant within85px, fanatic130px, goliath220px; destroyer/mercenary at least5 enemies within500px.
limitations: Balanced budgets only; no achievement rewards, consumables or gold pickups; max means full budgets, not all possible allocations.
Bot has perfect enemy coordinates; no leading shots, no character-specific tactics or Telepath pickup hovering.
Only art and ground stamps disabled; no rendering/performance inference.
Drop/wave streams separate, but same seed does not mean same killed enemies or collected drops. Weapon spread shares seeded stream with effects.
Pistol-only equal gear can diverge after ordinary drops. Ammo counts are final inventory, not total consumption.
Experimental enemy axes mutate test instances only; not proposed finished enemy types or armor. fast-weak:HP1/radius9/speed3x; durable:HP5x; heavy-contact:damage5x; swarm:3x count/HP1/radius9.
No damage-source, overheal or boss-time attribution; no manual play validation.
Orbit follows a slowly moving waypoint and can be trapped by packs. Compare kite strategy; these are bot outcomes, not human win rates. Runtime diagonal movement is unnormalized.
